items.text: Ladd McConkey ruled out mid-game with concussion after evaluation for head injury.
items.implication: Missed remainder; monitor protocol for next week.
items.opportunity: Targets to other Chargers WRs (e.g. Johnston/QJ).

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive for Browns; only Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (recent PS signee) available in backfield.
items.implication: Zero value; backfield thin and unproven.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive; Tyjae Spears active for Titans.
Late Sunday injuries watching: Davante Adams (leg/knee), Ladd McConkey (concussion, already out), Dalton Kincaid (ribs, returned), plus Doubs/Bateman/Mooney.
items.implication: Adams status key for Rams; Kincaid returned so likely fine.
items.opportunity: If Adams limited/out, other Rams WRs.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore inactive; Josh Palmer active.
items.implication: No value; targets to other Bills WRs.

items.text: Cam Skattebo 37th/43 in rush YOE with 4 fumbles (1 lost); Giants expected to increase Najee Harris role while keeping Skattebo in mix; all 4 RBs active.
items.why: Poor efficiency + fumbles driving rotation change per sources.
items.implication: Riskier flex; lower floor amid committee.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play / ruled OUT (hamstring) for MNF vs Commanders; Shanahan notes multi-week.
items.implication: Sit; targets redistribute to Evans/Kirk/Cooks if active.
items.opportunity: Mike Evans and other 49ers WRs volume bump.

items.text: Caleb Williams expected to play / back after full practices; confirmed return with Ben Johnson speeches.
items.implication: Start as usual; Bears offense stabilized.

items.text: Mike Evans questionable (ribs) for MNF; Christian Kirk also in mix with Deebo OUT; possible activation.
items.implication: Monitor inactives; high upside if active vs WAS.

items.text: AJ Brown and TreVeyon Henderson expected to play.
Chris Olave and Alvin Kamara expected to play.
Matthew Berry loves Mike Evans (WR4 vs WSH) and Drake London (WR6 vs CHI) for soft matchups and bankable usage.
items.why: Washington D buffet for pass catchers; London usage reliable.

items.text: Matthew Berry hates Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA) and Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT).
Berry loves Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @ GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ) for volume vs leaky run Ds and goal-line roles.
